sections.heading: Understanding Today's Market Shift
sections.body: As of August 25, 2026, bond yields are declining due to positive geopolitical developments, leading to lower mortgage rates. This environment is prompting brokers to consider alternative loan products like DSCR for non-owner occupied properties.
bullets: Bond yield drops linked to peace negotiations.
Oil prices influencing mortgage rate trends.

sections.heading: Why DSCR Loans Stand Out
sections.body: DSCR loans prioritize the property's income potential over the borrower's income, offering flexibility during economic uncertainty. With consumer confidence dipping, these loans support investments in income-generating properties.
bullets: Ideal for properties with strong rental history.
Flexible underwriting compared to conventional loans.
